basic_profile.bio: A recent university graduate exploring various career paths and hobbies. I have a keen interest in automotive technology and enjoy discussing topics related to education and student life. Based in Singapore, I am often online during late evenings and weekends. Currently working part-time while figuring out my next steps. Single and enjoying the flexibility that comes with it.
